title: Calibrations entered in XDrip cause NSClient to crash
symptom: When BG calibrations are entered in XDrip, it causes NSClient to crash. This makes it difficult to manage remotely via NSClient. The problem started after updating to AAPS v3.0.0.1.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but it is implied that calibrations entered in xDrip are passed to AAPS (NSClient) and then uploaded to Nightscout, causing a crash. The fix commit likely addresses the underlying issue.
